indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_capabilities_pkey ON mir_core.staff_capabilities USING btree (organization_id, user_id)

CREATE INDEX orders_owner ON mir_core.orders USING btree (organization_id, owner_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON mir_core.orders USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mir_orders_number ON mir_core.orders USING btree (organization_id, order_number) WHERE (order_number IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX mir_orders_job ON mir_core.orders USING btree (organization_id, job_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_revisions_pkey ON mir_core.order_revisions USING btree (organization_id, order_id, revision)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_pkey ON mir_core.messages USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_organization_id_sender_id_client_request_id_key ON mir_core.messages USING btree (organization_id, sender_id, client_request_id)
CREATE INDEX messages_conversation_time ON mir_core.messages USING btree (organization_id, conversation_id, sent_at DESC, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_activity_pkey ON mir_core.job_activity USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE INDEX job_activity_feed ON mir_core.job_activity USING btree (organization_id, job_id, created_at DESC, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_pkey ON mir_core.jobs USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_organization_id_name_key ON mir_core.jobs USING btree (organization_id, name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mir_jobs_number ON mir_core.jobs USING btree (organization_id, lower(job_number)) WHERE (job_number IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_documents_pkey ON mir_core.job_documents USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_documents_object_path_key ON mir_core.job_documents USING btree (object_path)

CREATE INDEX mir_job_documents_job ON mir_core.job_documents USING btree (organization_id, job_id, family_id, version DESC)
CREATE INDEX mir_job_documents_author ON mir_core.job_documents USING btree (created_by)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_memberships_pkey ON mir_core.job_memberships USING btree (organization_id, job_id, user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX team_day_assignments_pkey ON mir_core.team_day_assignments USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX team_day_assignments_organization_id_team_id_work_date_key ON mir_core.team_day_assignments USING btree (organization_id, team_id, work_date)
CREATE INDEX team_day_lookup ON mir_core.team_day_assignments USING btree (organization_id, work_date, leader_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX team_tasks_pkey ON mir_core.team_tasks USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE INDEX team_tasks_today ON mir_core.team_tasks USING btree (organization_id, team_id, work_date, completed_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX material_requests_pkey ON mir_core.material_requests USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX material_requests_organization_id_requested_by_client_reque_key ON mir_core.material_requests USING btree (organization_id, requested_by, client_request_id)
CREATE INDEX material_requests_pending ON mir_core.material_requests USING btree (organization_id, status, created_at) WHERE (status = 'pending'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_reports_pkey ON mir_core.daily_reports USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_reports_organization_id_leader_id_work_date_key ON mir_core.daily_reports USING btree (organization_id, leader_id, work_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_reports_organization_id_leader_id_client_request_id_key ON mir_core.daily_reports USING btree (organization_id, leader_id, client_request_id)
CREATE INDEX daily_reports_recent ON mir_core.daily_reports USING btree (organization_id, submitted_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX delivery_runs_pkey ON mir_core.delivery_runs USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX delivery_runs_organization_id_driver_id_client_request_id_key ON mir_core.delivery_runs USING btree (organization_id, driver_id, client_request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_run_per_vehicle ON mir_core.delivery_runs USING btree (organization_id, vehicle_id) WHERE (status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX delivery_run_orders_pkey ON mir_core.delivery_run_orders USING btree (organization_id, run_id, order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX time_entries_pkey ON mir_core.time_entries USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE INDEX time_entries_job_date ON mir_core.time_entries USING btree (organization_id, job_id, work_date DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_settings_pkey ON mir_core.punch_settings USING btree (organization_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_shifts_pkey ON mir_core.punch_shifts USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_one_active_shift ON mir_core.punch_shifts USING btree (organization_id, employee_id) WHERE (ended_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX punch_shifts_employee_date ON mir_core.punch_shifts USING btree (organization_id, employee_id, work_date DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_segments_pkey ON mir_core.punch_segments USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_one_active_segment ON mir_core.punch_segments USING btree (organization_id, shift_id) WHERE (ended_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_events_pkey ON mir_core.punch_events USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_events_organization_id_employee_id_request_id_key ON mir_core.punch_events USING btree (organization_id, employee_id, request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_corrections_pkey ON mir_core.punch_corrections USING btree (organization_id, id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_one_pending_lunch_request ON mir_core.punch_corrections USING btree (organization_id, employee_id, shift_id) WHERE ((correction_type = 'lunch_not_taken'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'clarification'::text])))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX time_periods_pkey ON mir_core.time_periods USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX time_periods_organization_id_starts_on_ends_on_key ON mir_core.time_periods USING btree (organization_id, starts_on, ends_on)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX time_bank_movements_pkey ON mir_core.time_bank_movements USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX punch_audit_pkey ON mir_core.punch_audit USING btree (organization_id, id)

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_memberships_pkey ON mir_core.job_memberships USING btree (organization_id, job_id, user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_pkey ON mir_core.jobs USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_organization_id_name_key ON mir_core.jobs USING btree (organization_id, name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX memberships_pkey ON mir_core.memberships USING btree (organization_id, user_id)
CREATE INDEX memberships_user ON mir_core.memberships USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX suppliers_pkey ON mir_core.suppliers USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_revisions_pkey ON mir_core.order_revisions USING btree (organization_id, order_id, revision)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX staff_capabilities_pkey ON mir_core.staff_capabilities USING btree (organization_id, user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON mir_core.orders USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE INDEX orders_owner ON mir_core.orders USING btree (organization_id, owner_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teams_pkey ON mir_core.teams USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teams_organization_id_name_key ON mir_core.teams USING btree (organization_id, name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversations_pkey ON mir_core.conversations USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversations_one_team ON mir_core.conversations USING btree (organization_id, team_id) WHERE (kind = 'team'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_pkey ON mir_core.messages USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_organization_id_sender_id_client_request_id_key ON mir_core.messages USING btree (organization_id, sender_id, client_request_id)
CREATE INDEX messages_conversation_time ON mir_core.messages USING btree (organization_id, conversation_id, sent_at DESC, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX extras_pkey ON mir_core.extras USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX extras_organization_id_created_by_client_request_id_key ON mir_core.extras USING btree (organization_id, created_by, client_request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_activity_pkey ON mir_core.job_activity USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE INDEX job_activity_feed ON mir_core.job_activity USING btree (organization_id, job_id, created_at DESC, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX team_day_assignments_pkey ON mir_core.team_day_assignments USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX team_day_assignments_organization_id_team_id_work_date_key ON mir_core.team_day_assignments USING btree (organization_id, team_id, work_date)
CREATE INDEX team_day_lookup ON mir_core.team_day_assignments USING btree (organization_id, work_date, leader_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX team_tasks_pkey ON mir_core.team_tasks USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE INDEX team_tasks_today ON mir_core.team_tasks USING btree (organization_id, team_id, work_date, completed_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX material_requests_pkey ON mir_core.material_requests USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX material_requests_organization_id_requested_by_client_reque_key ON mir_core.material_requests USING btree (organization_id, requested_by, client_request_id)
CREATE INDEX material_requests_pending ON mir_core.material_requests USING btree (organization_id, status, created_at) WHERE (status = 'pending'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_reports_pkey ON mir_core.daily_reports USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_reports_organization_id_leader_id_work_date_key ON mir_core.daily_reports USING btree (organization_id, leader_id, work_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_reports_organization_id_leader_id_client_request_id_key ON mir_core.daily_reports USING btree (organization_id, leader_id, client_request_id)
CREATE INDEX daily_reports_recent ON mir_core.daily_reports USING btree (organization_id, submitted_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX delivery_runs_pkey ON mir_core.delivery_runs USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX delivery_runs_organization_id_driver_id_client_request_id_key ON mir_core.delivery_runs USING btree (organization_id, driver_id, client_request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_run_per_vehicle ON mir_core.delivery_runs USING btree (organization_id, vehicle_id) WHERE (status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX delivery_run_orders_pkey ON mir_core.delivery_run_orders USING btree (organization_id, run_id, order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX time_entries_pkey ON mir_core.time_entries USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE INDEX time_entries_job_date ON mir_core.time_entries USING btree (organization_id, job_id, work_date DESC)
